verdict.rationale: Built-in AI for operations is a fair question for a banking platform with a dashboard, so the axis applies. The evidence covers payment APIs, webhooks, the dashboard, return correlation, an llms.txt file and a CLI, but none of it shows natural-language transaction search, drafted dispute or alert responses, or anomaly summaries. An llms.txt file makes the docs readable by external AI tools; it is not built-in AI.
